title: After the Arima Kinen: Ramen to Wash Down the Loss

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh man, I'm starving. G1 races sure do give you an appetite.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! One salt ramen, and… What are you feeling, Tannhauser?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: One salt and one soy sauce ramen, please.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Sigh… You were, like, fives times more amazing than I thought, Nature.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: As for me, I got butterflies and shivers down my spine during the race. I guess I wasn't mentally prepared—talk about frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But… I'll get you next time. Yeah, next time is mine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All right, let's eat! You can't race on an empty stomach!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I feel my energy coming back!
